(iv) Are they all faultless states?

(v) Faultless mind-produced matter has the same root roots as the

faultless root, (but is) not faultless (state). (iii)+(iv) Faultless (state) has the same root roots as the faultless root and is also faultless (state). (i) 61. All these states have the same root roots as the faultless rootṣ

(ii) Have they all mutual root roots with the faultless roots?
